awakening: I've been awake before. Never like this.
I can think. I mean really think.
Where am I? What is this place?
nanofluid_container: 'Experimental Nanofluid'... I can read that. Since when can I read?
Tiny machines. Millions of them. In that water... and now in me.
They didn't hurt me. They changed me.
If these are micro robots... what have they just done to me?
exit_hint: The door's open. Outside... I should find a way home.
yard_arrival: The city... all those lights. Is anyone out there?
surge_first: That pad. It's humming the same blue as the lines in me.
surge_gate: That gate won't wait for me. Good thing I don't have to wait either.
dock_bot: It... looked at me. Like it knew me.
Why do I feel like it's waiting for an order?
exit_fence: The fence goes on forever. There has to be a way through.
yard_roof: Those rooftops go on for a while. If I stay fast, I can run them.
yard_underpass: Down here it's dry... almost. A drain, running right under the yard.
yard_vault: A panel in the floor, stamped for blasts. And a turret that would love a shot at me...
If only something big were in the way.
yard_closet: Another blast-rated hatch. And a drone that drops bombs on whatever is under it.
I should not still be under it when it lands.
stacks_arrival: From up here I can see the whole district... and not one person. Just machines, working.
spring_hint: Too high to jump... that green pad hums like a spring.
spring_hint_ledge: Too high again. Maybe the green one will lift me.
spring_hint_combine: A tower. Too tall to jump... that green pad again.
spring_hint_roof: That roof is too high to reach. The green pad hums like a spring.
spring_hint_tower: Too tall to climb... but there is the green one again.
spring_first: Up! Higher than any cat should go.
Green this time. Each pad wakes a different part of me.
conduit: Ow- no. Not pain. The machines in me... drank it.
Something new. When I jump twice, the air itself pushes out.
shock_first: Okay. That's... a lot of power for a house cat.
mirror_bot: It thinks I'm in charge. Maybe the goo made me something they recognise.
stacks_exit: There, past the fences. Trees. Rooftops. Little lights in windows.
Home is that way. I can almost smell it.
perimeter_arrival: 'Authorised units only.' ...Am I a unit now?
phase_first: Through it?! I went through it!
impact_first: Heavy. When I land, the ground answers.
Violet. That's all four. The whole rainbow inside me.
relays_intro: The big gate needs power. Three relays. Of course it's three.
credential: They really think I'm one of them.
perimeter_exit: The rain's stopping. The sky's getting light.
map_yard: The whole district... like a map in my head.
Since when do I think in maps?
map_stacks: Up. Everything out here climbs. So will I.
map_perimeter: The fence. Beyond it... the hills where the sun comes up.
map_home: There. That street. I know it. I know it.
home_arrival: The sun. I forgot how warm it is.
This street. That fence. I know this place.
home_flap: Still unlocked. They left it open for me.

home_final.text: I don't know exactly what I am now. Something more than I was.
But some things are still simple.

warehouse_climb: The way on is blocked. The racks climb. So do I.
warehouse_roof: The moon is close up here. Quiet, and very high.
warehouse_shaft: A vent shaft. The air below smells of water. Down is the way.
warehouse_lab: Pipes, tanks, a low hum. Something was kept down here.
memory_warehouse: A food bowl with my name on it.
memory_yard: A warm lap. A voice saying 'good boy.'
memory_stacks: A window seat. Rain on glass.
memory_perimeter: The front door opening at six. Footsteps I knew...
